Fix `packages/core-plugin-api/src/routing/useRouteRef.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor (line 154): While the app is not ready, the placeholder `(() => pathname) as RouteFunc<Params>` is a new function on every render. A consumer that puts the returned link in a useEffect or useMemo dependency array re-runs on every render during startup. The resolved path does not have this problem because it is memoized. — fix: Memoize the placeholder on [pathname], for example with a useMemo placed next to the other hooks before any early return, and return that memoized function in the `!ready` branch.
